pending.reason: The default replay does not invoke Google login or use an account. Successful native provider authentication and returned identity remain unverified.
prerequisites: Installed iOS or Android release example with the matching Google client configuration
Approved dedicated Google QA account and staging callback configuration
Provider token and returned AuthUser fields inspected without recording token values
pending.acceptance: Complete one explicit Google sign-in on each requested platform, verify the returned public user belongs to Google, and confirm the backend accepts the signed identity before marking this row passed.

pending.reason: No Apple sign-in or account flow runs in the default replay.
prerequisites: Paid Apple Developer team and Sign in with Apple capability for the installed bundle
Dedicated Apple QA account and staging server verification route
pending.acceptance: Complete Apple login on iOS, verify the nonce-bound identity server-side, and record only non-secret provider and user-field evidence.

pending.reason: The signed-out-extended flow asserts only the configuration_error gate of an example build without a broker. No broker request runs, so broker and server behavior stay unproven.
prerequisites: Configured staging Apple broker and reachable server endpoint
Dedicated Apple QA account and Android release example configuration
pending.acceptance: Complete the Android broker flow, validate the returned nonce-bound token at the server, and verify the final public AuthUser without storing credential values in artifacts.

pending.reason: The default replay does not invoke Microsoft login or use a tenant account.
prerequisites: Registered staging application, redirect URI, and tenant policy for the installed target
Approved dedicated Microsoft QA account
pending.acceptance: Complete Microsoft sign-in on each requested platform, validate public provider/user fields, and record the final signed-in snapshot without token values.

pending.reason: No provider login is invoked, so loginAndGetUser success and atomic publication are not observed.
prerequisites: Provider-specific staging setup and dedicated accounts for Google, Apple, and Microsoft
Signed-in snapshot and lifecycle event capture with secrets redacted
pending.acceptance: For every configured provider, prove loginAndGetUser resolves the matching AuthUser and publishes the same user and scopes in one coherent session snapshot.

pending.reason: A signed-out token getter cannot validate real token refresh, rotation, expiry, or concurrent refresh behavior.
prerequisites: Staging provider session with a refreshable token and controlled expiry
Native operation event evidence for concurrent callers
pending.acceptance: Expire an approved test session, issue concurrent refresh requests, and prove one refresh produces a coherent replacement token/session before waiting requests continue; keep all token values out of artifacts.

pending.reason: The full-features flow checks local empty revoke and signed-out revokeAccess. The signed-out-extended flow calls requestScopes only after logout and asserts not_signed_in. Granted and declined provider consent is never requested.
prerequisites: Provider test account and requested consent scopes approved for the staging application
Separate account able to grant and decline the requested consent
Explicit provider QA run on an isolated target with known native account state
pending.acceptance: Prove granted and declined scope outcomes update the public session snapshot correctly, and never describe local revokeScopes as provider revocation.

pending.reason: The replay checks nonce shape only; it never requests a Google or Apple credential or sends it to a server.
prerequisites: Dedicated Google and Apple staging test accounts
Server-side signature, issuer, audience, expiry, and nonce verification evidence
pending.acceptance: Acquire each provider credential in a separate explicit run, verify it at the staging server, and preserve only redacted outcome evidence; do not write ID tokens, authorization codes, or raw nonces to replay artifacts.

pending.reason: The signed-out-extended flow asserts only the empty-session restore outcome on an account-free target (auth.silent-restore-empty). Restore of a cached-valid or revoked provider session is not exercised.
prerequisites: Dedicated QA device or simulator with known provider account state
Explicit opt-in restore run and post-run account cleanup plan
pending.acceptance: Run restore separately for cached-valid and revoked provider sessions; record the public outcome and final session state without token values.

pending.reason: Only the signed-out dispose and logout paths are replay-asserted, by auth.dispose-pending-event, auth.dispose-recreate, and auth.signed-out-logout in the signed-out-extended flow. Provider cancellation is not deterministic: on an Android release emulator, the Provider QA login probe opened Chrome or a Custom Tab (Chrome first-run sheet) before the synchronous logout cancellation landed. The Provider QA probes now accept cancelled or the explicit configuration_error setup gate, but they need an explicit manual run.
prerequisites: Configured provider test app and dedicated test account or deterministic provider fixture
Explicit manual Provider QA run on an isolated signed-out QA target with Chrome first-run completed on Android
Dedicated provider state because native logout may sign out the provider SDK
pending.acceptance: For login, loginAndGetUser, and getCredential on each provider, and for dispose during a live provider request, assert typed cancelled or configuration_error, no published user, an empty recreated snapshot, and no token or credential text in artifacts, with provider UI handled deterministically.

pending.reason: The signed-out-extended flow asserts logout only on an empty session (auth.signed-out-logout). Logout of a signed-in provider session is not exercised.
prerequisites: Dedicated provider test account and an isolated target
Known provider and package session state before logout
pending.acceptance: With a signed-in test package session, verify logout clears the public user and scopes, terminates pending work as documented, and does not alter another installation or account session.

pending.reason: The package does not expose createNonce through its web AuthService surface, so the credentials screen reports the native nonce check as pending on web.
prerequisites: A supported public web nonce API, if browser nonce coverage is required
pending.acceptance: Keep the web nonce row pending until a public web nonce API exists; do not call a native HybridObject or report web as a native nonce failure.
